1 Entry 553: sharp logarithmic measurement growth
We retain precisely the information model of entry 553 [1]: each branch functional is continuous
in the input, while the dependence on the preceding exact measurements and the final decoder
may be arbitrary. The known upper bound is Theorem 1 of Krieg–Novak–Ullrich, version 2 [2].
Here N (m)is the least number of adaptive measurements allowing, for everyε >0, recovery
of everyx∈Rm with worst-case error at mostε. The first measurement is continuous onRm;
after any fixed history, the next measurement is again continuous as a function of the input.
